title: Deep Learning-Based Mesoscopic Emission Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traffic-related emissions are a major contributor to urban air pollution. However, existing emission models face a fundamental trade-off: macroscopic models are computationally efficient but rely on average speeds, leading to systematic errors, while microscopic models achieve high accuracy but are computationally prohibitive for large scale simulations. To bridge this gap, this study introduces Direct Emission Prediction (DEP), a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)-based deep learning model. DEP was trained on over one million synthetic trips generated by coupling real-world GNSS speed profiles with the microscopic emission model MOBSim. By processing sequential link-level inputs, including vehicle characteristics, road attributes, and ambient temperature, DEP predicts CO$_2$ and NOx emissions. translated_title: 基于深度学习的介观排放建模
translated_abstract: 交通相关排放是城市空气污染的主要来源之一。然而，现有排放模型面临一个根本性的权衡：宏观模型计算效率高，但依赖平均速度，会导致系统性误差；而微观模型虽然精度高，但对于大规模模拟而言计算成本过高，令人望而却步。为弥合这一差距，本研究提出了直接排放预测（DEP），一种基于门控循环单元（GRU）的深度学习模型。DEP 通过将真实世界的 GNSS 速度轨迹与微观排放模型 MOBSim 相耦合，生成了超过一百万次合成出行数据用于训练。通过处理顺序的路段级输入，包括车辆特性、道路属性和环境温度，DEP 可预测 CO₂ 和 NOx 排放。我们将 DEP 集成到基于 MATSim 的工作流程中，并将其应用于法兰西岛（Île-de-France）地区。结果表明，DEP 的精度可与一种介观-微观混合模型 SPG-M 相媲美（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究提出基于GRU的深度学习模型DEP，通过学习由真实GNSS轨迹与微观排放模型MOBSim耦合生成的超百万条合成出行数据，直接预测路段级CO₂和NOx排放，在精度上媲美混合模型的同时实现了计算高效的介观尺度排放建模，并成功集成于法兰西岛地区的MATSim模拟流程。
en_tdlr: This study introduces DEP, a GRU-based deep learning model trained on over one million synthetic trips coupling real-world GNSS speed profiles with the microscopic emission model MOBSim, enabling accurate yet computationally efficient mesoscopic prediction of link-level CO₂ and NOx emissions within a MATSim-based workflow applied to the Île-de-France region.
